label: BRAND_BUILDS

optionalProps.awareness_lift: number (0-1) — 对应brand.json的awareness字段的变化率
optionalProps.premium_ratio_change: number — 对应brand.json的premium_ratio字段的变化
optionalProps.confidence_interval: number (0-1) — 因果推断置信区间

transfer_function: revenue_lift = brand_investment * f(awareness_lift, premium_ratio_change, repeat_purchase_lift, nps_change, lag_months)

diagnostic_signals.brand_decay: lag_months > 12 AND awareness_lift < 0 AND repeat_purchase_lift < 0 — 品牌资产衰减

description: 品牌建设活动→长期营收转化。6-18个月滞后期。学术基础：Aaker(1991)品牌资产理论、Keller(1993)CBBE模型。数据映射：awareness_lift←brand.json.awareness变化率, premium_ratio_change←brand.json.premium_ratio变化, repeat_purchase_lift←brand.json.repeat_purchase_rate变化, nps_change←brand.json.nps变化。
